longTitle: A Bill to amend the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to enable local planning authorities to use sums received under section 106 of the Act for the building and improvement of housing; and for connected purposes.
summary: This Bill would enable money paid by developers under section 106 of the Act (also known as planning gain or planning obligation) to be used for building, maintaining or improving residential premises.
shortTitle: Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (Amendment) Bill
